display_long_description:
# Ever dreamed of being a monkey exploring the skies with your friends? Now you can!

Welcome to Monke Up — a chaotic co-op VR adventure where teamwork is the only way up. Build, climb, parkour, and jump your way through floating islands as you and your friends work together to reach new heights.


🧱 Use our unique **building mechanic** to create paths anywhere — players love the freedom it brings!

[media]

🐒 Master movement with smooth climbing and parkour gameplay.
[media]

🎮 Play together in **4-player co-op** and conquer the skies as a team.

[media]

Monke Up is in *Early Access*, with regular content updates on the way. Jump in now and be part of the growing Monke Army!

[media]
